name: theo.site
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But next.js 15.5.19 has known flaws.
lesson: Check front-end library versions against a known-flaw list on every release, and upgrade the ones that are flagged.
summary: theo.site scores 82 out of 100 (B). 2 checks fail now, 11 are at risk, and 43 pass. Fix first: next.js 15.5.19 has known flaws.

fix.title: Next.js 15.5.19 has known flaws
fix.evidence: Next.js 15.5.19 (read from the page): 12 known flaws, the worst rated critical, such as CVE-2026-64645, CVE-2026-64647, CVE-2026-64646. Next.js: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Image Optimization API when AVIF files are used. Checked against the…

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw TikTok Pixel (6 requests), Meta Pixel (2 requests), Google Analytics (2 requests), Google Ads (1 request), and cookies _ttp on tiktok.com, _ga_GC31VW6PZ2, _ga,…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /product, /grow-traffic, for example .working-chatbox-status:nth-child(2) and .working-chatbox-working. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: A window the page opens, or that opens it, keeps a handle to it, which tabnabbing and cross-site leaks use. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin-allow-popups, or same-origin when the site opens no sign-in or payment popup.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 197 ms
Every page has a meta description
